## The Real Estate Staffing Challenge

Real estate is cyclical. Hot markets require immediate capacity, but permanent hires become overhead when markets cool.

Transaction volume fluctuates unpredictably. You need coordinators and support staff who can scale with your deal flow.

Finding licensed professionals who understand your market and can represent your brand properly is challenging and time-consuming.

### The TaaSFlow Solution

- Licensed agents and brokers with state license verification
- Transaction coordinators experienced with high-volume deal flow
- Property managers with residential and commercial portfolio experience
- Administrative support familiar with real estate operations and software
- Market-specific experience: residential, commercial, multifamily, industrial
